findings.finding: checkImageUpdate returns driver.Fixable("", "--update is not supported for --driver %s yet", drv): warden prints the error with no 'To fix:' line. UX-04 item 1 lists a bad flag as a failure with a clear cause whose Fix is the exact change that resolves it. The message implies the remedy but does not state it, and FixableError allows an empty Fix only when Msg already says what to do. The check itself is right: it runs before anything is downloaded, and it is tested (TestCheckImageUpdate). The design's approved message is kept either way.
findings.suggestion: Give it a fix, e.g. driver.Fixable("drop --update (only --driver vz supports it so far)", "--update is not supported for --driver %s yet", drv), and extend TestCheckImageUpdate to assert the fix is non-empty.

suppressions_note: None: no previous report, no Tier1-Allow trailers on the branch.
back_to_design_note: No. The implementation follows Decisions 1 to 8 and the prepare pseudocode: the --update refusal precedes classify, SetActive precedes the IPSW deletion and the warning, the warning fires only after a no-source refresh of an existing active image, and a failed lookup prints nothing. Both departures are reported and need only a text update at Consolidation.

informational: UX-02: image list has no machine-readable form on main either; this diff extends its text lines (state and IPSW columns, documented in cli.md). Not a regression, so not filed; worth a note when a --json pass over the CLI is queued.

The active pointer is <cache>/active in ~/.cache/warden/images, a directory the qemu linux images and their layers.json share (as the vz images already did). Nothing on main globs a bare 'active', but a more specific name (vz-active) would avoid any later collision. Not a rule finding.
